__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He wants to see what's on the other side of the mountain too.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A mountain climber is making the same trek that you are.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: mountain climber mountainclimber

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: He looks like he's about to have dinner (maybe it's you?).
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A hungry cyclops snarls at you!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: cyclops

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Rather small for an elemental form, looks like a reject.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A tiny elemental form wanders about.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle tiny elemental

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: You can't tell which kind of elemental it is, maybe it's a bit o' all of them?
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The elemental guardian of the canyon.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle elemental guardian

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A small elemental, a resident of the canyon.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small, rather non-descript elemental.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle small elemental

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A medium elemental, a resident of the canyon.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A medium-sized elemental.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle medium elemental

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A large elemental, a resident of the canyon.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A large elemental.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle large elemental

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He looks as old as the earth itself.  He seems to know all the
secrets and knowledge of the Earth.  You can't really tell where
he begins and the rock wall ends.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Ruler of the earth elementals.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle earth elemental ruler

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: As you look at him he seems to blend in with the fire in his throne.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Ruler of the fire elementals.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle fire elemental ruler

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: As you peer at him you seem to be looking at the sky itself.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Ruler of the air elementals.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle air elemental ruler

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
As you examine him there is a blinding flash of light and a deafening boom!
You rub your eyes and look and the ruler is there grinning at you.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Ruler of the lightning elementals.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle lightning elemental ruler

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
As you look at him he changes to mist, which swirls around you.  Just
as you get scared, it reforms in elemental form.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Ruler of the water elementals.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle water elemental ruler

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It trickles along the ground and gets your feet wet.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small puddle of water elemental.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle water puddle elemental

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It smolders along the grass aimlessly.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small flickering flame elemental.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle fire flame elemental

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It looks a little blue.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A frozen snowflake water elemental.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle snowflake snow flake ice elemental

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It seems to be a small living pebble!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small rock.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle pebble rock earth stone elemental

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Zipping from place to place at the speed of light is tough work.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small spark of electricity fizzles here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle spark lightning energy elemental

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The magical blob of acid is a cross between lightning and water.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small blob of acid aimlessly eats away at the stone.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle acid blob elemental

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The magical lava beast is a cross between fire and earth.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A lava beast spews from place to place.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle lava elemental

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The magical mud monster is a cross between water and earth.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A mud monster slops around.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle mud elemental

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The magical mist is a cross between water and air.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The air is magically misty here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle mist elemental

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The magical manifestation of energy.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A sub-atomic particle is too small for you to see.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle particle elemental

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The magical dust cloud is a cross between air and earth.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A dust cloud blowing by makes you sneeze.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle dust elemental

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The magical eddie current is a manifestation of an air elemental.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A small eddie current swirls junk around here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle eddie elemental

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
As you look you see what seems to be a face and almost a
humanoid figure somehow trapped in the fire.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Blue Flame burns mysteriously here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle blue flame

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A humanoid figure seems to be trapped in the field of the Magneto.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Magneto considers zapping you for the heck of it.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle magneto

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A humanoid figure encased in ice but still apparently alive.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Ice Bandit strikes cold fear in your heart.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle ice bandit

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A humanoid figure trapped in stone seems alive.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The Rock Monster considers you in stoney silence.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle rock monster

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: A humanoid figure is trapped in the rushing wind.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A Hurricane rages across the sky.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle hurricane

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The elemental magician has come here in search of the fabled
Stone of Surrender which can be used to render opponents senseless.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An elemental magician seeks magical stones for a spell.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle magician

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
The Rainbow Cult has received special powers for their service to
the elemental forces.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A warrior of the Rainbow Cult swears his loyalty.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle rainbow warrior

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description:
He seeks their aid for a powerful new spell of deception.

<wielded>            The Sword of Illusions
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: The illusionist seeks the aid of the elemental forces.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle illusionist

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: Rare herbs are rumored to grow only in the canyon.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: An alchemist wanders by in search of magical herbs.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle alchemist

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: It's only a baby by dragon standards.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A baby rainbow dragon plays among the elements here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle baby rainbow dragon

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: The little bugger steals stuff and is generally obnoxious.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A little imp runs along being annoying.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle imp

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: HUGE, need i say more?
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A HUGE elemental form stands here.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle huge elemental

__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.description: I WOULD NOT suggest you attack me ...!
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.long_descr: A vendor is willing to sell you elixirs.
__class__/rom24.handler_npc.Npc.name: oldstyle vendor
